cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Jamii Afya is an offline clinical decision-support advisor for community health workers in rural and peri-urban African clinics, including English/Kiswahili settings in East Africa. It supports childhood danger-sign, pregnancy-red-flag, injury, and referral conversations when connectivity is unreliable and patient data should remain local. Its design is driven by primary-care clinical workflows and bilingual patient communication, so the medical discipline is load-bearing on both the knowledge base and the safety behaviour. No weight-level fine-tuning was performed; the submission focuses on adaptable systems engineering, sparse execution, bounded staging, and offline runtime delivery.

test_prompts.prompt: Mtoto wa miaka miwili ana joto la nyuzi 39 Celsius na kikohozi kikavu, na anapumua haraka. Kama mhudumu wa afya kijijini, nifanye tathmini na hatua gani za kwanza?

A pregnant woman at 30 weeks presents with severe headache, blurred vision, and swelling of the face. What danger signs should I check for and what should I do in a rural clinic without a doctor on site?
